posts.title: Wooden Chair Construction
posts.description: I have two identical folding chairs that I really like. I do not remember where they came from, but they are nice pieces of furniture. They are all oak, beautifully worn in, and feel nice to sit in. Another appealing aspect of this design is that it folds up completely into one plane, which is something I haven’t seen in other chairs. posts.title: Printable Calendar Generator
posts.description: A project that has caught my attention recently has been a printable calendar generator . posts.title: Kafka on the Shore
posts.description: I had once mentioned in passing to some others that I had planned to write a short story.
